cases.d: The Secretary records attendance during the meeting.
steps: On the roster, set members to Có mặt or Vắng in the Điểm danh column.
Try the same on a meeting that has not started.
exp: "Lưu điểm danh thành công." appears and each row shows who recorded it and when.
On a meeting not in progress: "Chỉ được điểm danh khi cuộc họp đang diễn ra.".
pre: A meeting with members; signed in as its Secretary.

cases.d: Members see attendance but cannot change it.
steps: As thanhvien, open the roster of a meeting in progress.
exp: The Điểm danh column is visible (Có mặt, Vắng, Chưa điểm danh).
No control to change attendance is offered.
pre: A meeting in progress where thanhvien is invited.

cases.d: Guests are recorded too and the recorder and time are shown.
steps: As the Secretary, set the guest to Có mặt.
Hover the attendance of the guest.
exp: The guest row (tag Khách) saves like a member.
The tooltip shows who recorded it and when, e.g. "Nguyễn Thư Ký điểm danh lúc 09:05 23/10/2026".
pre: A meeting in progress with a guest invitation.
